title: Email/get: N serial queries each loading full raw_message blob
description:
handle_email_get() (email/get.rs) iterates over IDs sequentially and calls fetch_smtp_email() once per ID. Each call issues:

  SELECT raw_message, mailbox_id, received_at FROM mailbox_messages WHERE id=? AND user_id=?

Two problems: (1) N serial round-trips for an N-ID batch. RFC 8621 allows up to 500 IDs per Email/get. At 500 IDs this is 500 sequential SQLite queries. A single IN-clause query would retrieve all rows in one round-trip. (2) raw_message is always fetched regardless of requested properties. The properties parameter is accepted but immediately discarded (let _ = properties). A client requesting only subject or from still loads the full RFC 822 blob for every message. For a 500-message batch with 100 KB messages this is 50 MB of blob I/O to return a few header fields.

Fix for (1): batch with SELECT ... WHERE id IN (?,?,?) AND user_id=? when all IDs are smtp: type. Fix for (2): implement properties filtering — either add indexed header columns to the schema, or accept that blob fetch is always required and document it; in either case problem (1) should be fixed first.
